description: Defines the VtigerWebserviceObject class which manages web service entity objects, including caching and retrieval by name, id, and query, with methods to access entity properties.

classes.name: VtigerWebserviceObject
classes.description: Represents a web service entity object with caching mechanisms for name and id lookups, and methods to retrieve entity properties.

methods.name: fromName
methods.description: Retrieves a VtigerWebserviceObject instance based on the entity name, using cache or database query.

methods.name: fromId
methods.description: Retrieves a VtigerWebserviceObject instance based on the entity id, using cache or database query.

methods.name: fromQuery
methods.description: Parses a query string to extract the entity name and retrieves the corresponding object.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the id of the entity.

methods.name: getHandlerPath
methods.description: Returns the handler path for the entity.

methods.name: getHandlerClass
methods.description: Returns the handler class for the entity.
